name: Leaving Parents
overview: Scripture teaches that leaving parents is a God-ordained step tied closely to the covenant of marriage, where a man leaves his father and mother to unite with his wife, becoming one flesh, as emphasized in Genesis 2:24, Matthew 19:5-6, and Ephesians 5:31. This leaving signifies a transition from the parental home to a new, God-established family unit. Furthermore, Proverbs 22:6 underscores the importance of godly training in childhood, preparing one to uphold this commitment faithfully in adulthood.
